niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers light, airy, high-readability interfaces with clear top-down hierarchy, strong section structure, and generous spacing. They favor screens that feel organized and scannable: clear titles, visible labels, explicit actions, separated cards or rows, and compact but readable information presentation. They often like pill-style filters/chips, cohesive modern styling, and layouts that foreground the current task without unnecessary competing UI. They generally reject heavy dark canvases, low-contrast text, fragmented hierarchy, crowded mixed-control rows, and interfaces where actions or structure are ambiguous.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong, structured hierarchy with clear titles, section headings, organized grouping, and obvious top-down flow.
Prefers highly readable content, especially dark text on light surfaces, with clear separation between title, metadata, and supporting text.
Prefers light, airy, neutral backgrounds and rejects heavy, dark, visually weighty screens.
Prefers breathing room, balanced spacing, and layouts that avoid cramped stacking or compressed sections.
Prefers actions that are clearly labeled, visible, and easy to discover rather than hidden, icon-only, or weakly signaled.
Prefers information arranged for quick scanning using chips, bullets, badges, grouped metadata, or clearly structured rows/cards.
Prefers rounded pill filters, chips, or segmented controls with distinct active states and stronger visual separation.
